# Keep drop target, current row and selected row as distinct states

The current folder row drop-target shares the selected.current focused palette, even when the tree itself lacks focus. A selected row alone uses a different palette. Preserve drop-target as a distinct semantic class rather than treating it as a synonym for selected. These state class names are part of the existing folder-list contract. No real drag, high-contrast or keyboard run was made.

Scope: mail/themes/shared/mail.
